pages.title: Your first steps
pages.text: Ariente technology grows from $(item)blueprints$(), minerals and two kinds of flux. Start by collecting Silver, Platinum and Silicon, then craft a $(l:ariente:construction/constructor)Constructor$(/l) and $(l:ariente:construction/blueprints)Blueprint Storage$(/l). Find a populated blueprint, gather its ingredients, and make your first machine.

pages.title: Choose your adventure
pages.text: With ArienteWorld installed, expeditions to alien cities supply blueprints, equipment and resources. Its chapter appears on this tablet.$(br2)With Ariente alone, the default world settings supply Overworld ores and blueprints in dungeon loot. Explore newly generated terrain and search dungeon chests. A modpack may change these defaults.
Seven Iron Ingots form the casing; a Glass Pane and Redstone make the display. Use the tablet in either hand to open this manual. It needs no fuel.
